It is located in the village of Ahunapalu in Kastre Parish, Tartu County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 195.6 hectares (483 acres). The lake has an average depth of 1.0 meter (3 ft 3 in) and a maximum depth of 1.4 meters (4 ft 7 in). It is 3,460 meters (11,350 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 11,930 meters (39,140 ft). It has a volume of 1,722,000 cubic meters (60,800,000 cu ft).
